title: 3.0.0.1 - Hypo TT replaces Active TT
symptom: When a temporary target such as Activity is running, a hypo Temp Target replaces the active Temp Target. After the hypo TT expires, the TT does not return to the previous activity target but instead reverts to the default profile target.
cause: The system changes the temp target without the user noticing; the hypo TT is set by automation or when adding carbs, and it replaces the existing TT rather than stacking or restoring the previous one.
evidence_quote: When the user sets a new temp target, it is expected it replaces the old one. But in this case, the systems change the temp target without the user noticing, which is undesired in this case.
